section_a_evaluate.assessment: 100% overstated. All 10 Section A Evaluate claims are ASC rule application with stakeholder window dressing. The Pack E authoring pattern of adding named CFOs/controllers to deterministic GAAP questions created systematic Evaluate mislabeling in Section A.

section_a_analyze.assessment: 71% accurate. Two items (A-035, A-063) are Apply-level but have legitimate decomposition elements; A-063 is clearly Apply.

section_b.assessment: B-063 is Remember (definition match); B-044 is legitimate Analyze (trend pattern + comparative MA selection).

section_c.assessment: EVAL-004 is genuine Evaluate; C-044 and C-059 are formula-substitution Apply; C-004, C-011, C-014, C-049 are legitimate Analyze.

section_d.assessment: EVAL-001 is genuine Evaluate; D-030 is Apply (special order formula); D-034 is legitimate Analyze.

section_e.assessment: EVAL-002 is genuine Evaluate; R10 is Apply (constrained selection); E-013 and E-034 are legitimate Analyze.

section_f.assessment: 78% accurate for Evaluate — technology governance items are genuinely evaluative. F-004 is Remember (definition match). All 6 Analyze claims confirmed.

certified_pool_impact.assessment: 14 Certified items are labeled Evaluate but test at lower cognitive levels (10 Apply, 2 Analyze, 2 Remember). 3 Certified items are labeled Analyze but test at Apply. The 5 EVAL-series items are Unprocessed. This is a pedagogical metadata defect (wrong CognitiveLevel field), not a correctness or learner-safety defect. All items have correct answer keys, correct explanations, and are DL-008/DL-026 clean per existing defect sweep data.

recommendations: Reclassify all 10 Pack E Section A Evaluate items to their true cognitive levels (7 to Apply, 2 to Analyze, 1 to Remember)
Reclassify P1E-B-063 (Evaluate→Remember) and P1E-F-004 (Evaluate→Remember) as definition-match items
Reclassify P1E-D-030 (Evaluate→Apply) as formula-application special order decision
Reclassify P1-E-R10 (Evaluate→Apply) as constrained compensating control selection
Reclassify P1E-C-044 (Analyze→Apply) and P1E-C-059 (Analyze→Apply) as formula-substitution items
Reclassify P1E-A-063 (Analyze→Apply) as accounting principle change procedure execution
Preserve all 7 confirmed Pack E Section F Evaluate items (F-012, F-015, F-016, F-023, F-025, F-036, F-065) — these are genuine technology governance evaluations
Preserve all 5 EVAL-series items (EVAL-001 through EVAL-005) as gold-standard Evaluate items
Consider upgrading P1E-A-005 and P1E-A-006 from Evaluate to Analyze (not Apply) — they have genuine multi-step decomposition and comparative elements

Run a parallel audit on Pack A HO items using the same rubric to cross-validate the Section A Evaluate pattern (S93P already shows Section A Evaluate accuracy at 25% in Pack A, consistent with this Pack E finding)
